timeline_reconstruction.fact: WHO Director-General declared the 2019-nCoV outbreak a PHEIC (30 Jan 2020).
Italy extended DPCM 8 Mar 2020 measures to the entire national territory (9 Mar 2020).
On 11 March 2020 WHO characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic — the global escalation preamble marking the shift from outbreak to pandemic.
WHO assessed that COVID-19 could be characterized as a pandemic.
WHO ended the COVID-19 PHEIC (15th IHR Emergency Committee, 5 May 2023).
SVB Financial Group disclosed the completed sale of its available-for-sale securities portfolio (~$24bn book, ~$1.8bn after-tax loss) on 8 Mar 2023 - the liquidity-stress trigger.
FDIC records the closure and receivership.
U.S. authorities announced a systemic-risk exception protecting all SVB depositors and access to funds from 13 March 2023.
FINMA approved the takeover of Credit Suisse by UBS; extraordinary government support triggered a full write-down of ~CHF 16bn AT1 debt - the cross-border bank-resolution event.
FDIC: JPMorgan Chase assumed all deposits of First Republic Bank (1 May 2023).
IEA Oil Market Report (March 2023) documented the banking-turmoil-driven oil sell-off (post-SVB) that framed the supply backdrop ahead of the 2023 Saudi/OPEC+ voluntary cuts.
The outlook supplies the pre-cut oil baseline.
OPEC documented additional voluntary production adjustments totaling 1.66 million barrels per day as a precautionary market-stability measure.

On 4 June 2023, at the OPEC+ ministerial meeting, Saudi Arabia announced an additional voluntary crude production cut of 1 million bpd, effective July 2023 and potentially extendable — a supply-tightening amplification within the oil/OPEC+ event.
On 2 June 2024 OPEC+ agreed to gradually phase out the voluntary production cuts on a monthly basis through the end of September 2025 — a staged supply normalization after the 2023 tightening.
The UN Special Coordinator condemned the multi-front Hamas assault against Israeli towns and the rocket barrage on 7 October 2023.
EIA stated that the attacks on Israel raised the potential for oil supply disruptions and higher prices, while noting no physical-market impact at the report cutoff.

On 19 November 2023 Houthi forces seized the cargo ship Galaxy Leader in the Red Sea, opening the Red Sea shipping-attack escalation that the IMO Secretary-General subsequently condemned — a conflict-phase amplification of the Red Sea shipping-risk event.
U.S. DoD established Operation Prosperity Guardian, a multinational Red Sea navigation-security initiative (Dec 18, 2023).
On 11–12 January 2024 the U.S. and U.K. conducted joint airstrikes against Houthi targets in Yemen in response to Red Sea shipping attacks — a policy-response escalation.
On 28 July 2023 the Bank of Japan increased the flexibility of yield curve control, allowing the 10-year JGB yield to rise toward 1.0% — an early normalization step.
The outlook supplies the policy-normalization baseline.

On 19 March 2024 the Bank of Japan ended negative interest rates for the first time since 2007, guiding the uncollateralized overnight call rate to around 0 to 0.1 percent — the start of policy normalization.
The Bank of Japan ended the negative-interest-rate/YCC framework and guided the uncollateralized overnight call rate to around 0 to 0.1 percent.

On 5 August 2024 the Nikkei 225 crashed 12.40% (down 4,451.28 points), its worst single-day drop since the 1987 "Black Monday" — an escalation/amplification shock tied to BOJ tightening and the yen carry-trade unwind.
The report supplies the pre-package macro and credit baseline.
The Federal Reserve lowered its target range by 50 basis points, an external policy backdrop only; it does not prove the cause of China policy actions.
At the 24 September 2024 State Council Information Office briefing, the PBOC announced reserve-ratio and policy-rate cuts, lower existing mortgage rates, and new stock-market support tools.
On 24 September 2024 the PBOC announced an RRR cut and instructed commercial banks to batch-adjust existing mortgage rates by 31 October 2024 — a household-balance-sheet easing measure.
On 24 September 2024 the PBOC created the Securities/Funds/Insurance Companies Swap Facility (SFISF), first tranche RMB 500 billion — a capital-market support instrument of the stimulus package.
The "America First Trade Policy" Presidential Memorandum (Jan 20 2025) directed reciprocal-trade investigations - the policy baseline before the April reciprocal tariff.
The order established a broad reciprocal tariff framework.
The fact sheet describes the measures and transmission logic.
EO 14257 Annex I sets country-specific ad valorem duty rates effective 12:01 a.m. EDT 9 Apr 2025; U.S. Customs and Border Protection executes the rates at the border.

Executive Order 14266 temporarily suspended most Annex I country-specific rates for 90 days and applied a 10 percent additional rate from 10 April 2025, while increasing the China rate following retaliation.
